name: GaMS-9B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from google/gemma-2-9b (config.json max_position_embeddings 8192). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-04. A finetune of google/gemma-2-9b, not a new base model: continual pretraining on Slovene, English and a smaller Croatian/Serbian/Bosnian share, with the architecture left untouched (identical tensor set, 9.242B, 42 layers, hidden 3584, 8 KV heads x head_dim 256). Recorded as a contender on a same-table comparison: the card's Slovene SuperGLUE table prints 'GaMS-9B 0.7309' and 'Gemma 2 9B 0.6980' as neighbouring rows, evaluated in the same run, so the +3.3pp average is a same-harness delta. Read it narrowly. The task is a Slovene-only classification suite (BoolQ, CB, COPA, MultiRC, RTE, WSC) at 3-shot with guided decoding, and MultiRC was run 0-shot while everything else was 3-shot - a split the card states. The model LOSES BoolQ (0.700 vs 0.833), so this is not a uniform upgrade. The same table also shows PrešernGPT 0.1 at 0.7568 and GaMS-27B at 0.7601, i.e. a competitor and the larger sibling both beat this model. Licence is the Gemma licence, not Apache: downstream use inherits Google's Gemma terms. Repo created 2025-02-10.
